jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (DE/FR) - Service Desk 80 - 100%
jobs.description: Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Geschäftskunden bei technischen Fragen und Störungen. Mit deinem Know-how sorgst du dafür, dass Services schnell wieder funktionieren und unsere Kund:innen sich auf uns verlassen können. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Du nimmst technische Störungen auf, priorisierst sie und löst sie eigenständig (1st Level) - Du führst erste Analysen im Bereich Netzwerk, Internet und VoIP durch - Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen, um Störungen schnell zu beheben - Du koordinierst Techniker-Einsätze und hältst Kund:innen proaktiv über den Fortschritt informiert - Du bearbeitest Incidents, Requests und Changes im Ticketsystem - Du eskalierst komplexe Cases an 2nd Level, wenn nötig - Du arbeitest im 24/7 Schichtbetrieb DEINE SKILLS:​ - Ausbildung im IT-/Telekom-Bereich oder relevante Erfahrung im technischen Support - Erste praktische Erfahrung im IT Support, Service Desk oder Network Operations - Erste Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerken (IP, Routing, VPN, LAN/WAN) - Interesse an ICT-Technologien und Weiterentwicklung - Klare, kundenorientierte Kommunikation und Teamspirit - Sehr gute Deutsch- und Französischkenntnisse sind für diese Rolle erforderlich Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert. Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft! #ChallengersWanted Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungsunterlagen, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichen Stellen eingesandt oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht und werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht. #LI-ST1

jobs.title: Sales Agent Bern Railcity 60-100%
jobs.description:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte. Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte. - Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und sorgst für eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Shop. - Du unterstützt Kundinnen und Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceanliegen und agierst dabei professionell und lösungsorientiert. - Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative
• Aufgaben effizient. - Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service. DEINE SKILLS: - Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimediabranche – oder du bist ein/e motivierte/r Quereinsteiger/-in mit Verkaufsflair. - Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends. - Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi. - Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen. - Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden. - Du bringst die nötige Flexibilität mit, um im Schichtbetrieb in einem Shop zu arbeiten, der an sieben Tagen pro Woche geöffnet ist – dazu gehören regelmässige Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze. - Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus. Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert. Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft! #ChallengersWanted Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungsunterlagen, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichen Stellen eingesandt oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht und werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht. #LI-TW1

jobs.title: Head of Data Science & Analytics 80-100%
jobs.description: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. As Head of Data Science & Analytics, you will work at the intersection of data, decision science, and real-world impact. You will lead a team of 10 specialists to address some of Sunrise’s most critical business challenges, applying rigorous analysis guided by pragmatic judgment to ensure decisions are both well-founded and actionable. As a leader, you will act as a coach, translator, builder, and strategist, shaping how data informs decisions across the organization. YOUR CHALLENGE: - Lead and develop the Data Science & Analytics team, including coaching, capability building, and people development - Define what good looks like for Data Science & Analytics by setting standards and best practices, supported by playbooks, training materials, and delivery frameworks - Ensure high-quality delivery across Data Science & Analytics contributions in a matrix setup - Partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and senior leaders to translate business questions into analytical problems, and turn insights into decisions - Support high-value decisions through analytics, experimentation, impact measurement, and advanced analytical methods such as causal inference - bringing rigorous evidence and constructive challenge to the company’s most important questions - Build a community for data-driven decision-making across Sunrise by driving knowledge exchange, promoting best practices, and raising analytical fluency across the organization YOUR SKILLS: - Proven people leadership experience, including line management, coaching, and developing high-performing teams - Strong expertise in advanced analytics for decisioning, ideally including causal inference, experimentation, impact measurement, and related statistical methods, supported by an advanced degree in a STEM field, economics, business informatics, or similar - Deep hands-on analytics coding skills, ideally in both Python and R, with the ability to guide others on methodological and technical quality - Excellent advisory and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders credibly, constructively challenge assumptions, and turn analysis into decisions - Strong business acumen and the ability to focus teams on the work that creates the highest return on investment - A pragmatic consulting mindset paired with strong delivery focus and sound judgment - Fluency in English; German advantageous At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-SJ1

As a Senior DC Network Engineer, you’ll take a key role in engineering and developing Sunrise’ Datacenter, Shop, and Office networks. From designing robust infrastructure to authoring blueprints and technical guidelines, you’ll be at the heart of building and optimizing our network backbone. jobs.description: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes. In this role you will enable Sunrise to design, deploy and continuously improve production‑grade agentic and conversational AI solutions across customer and employee workflows. You will provide shared frameworks, standards and quality gates to ensure AI behaviour is predictable, grounded in governed enterprise knowledge and data, safe, multilingual and operationally ready. You will partner with ADAO Domain Pods and engineering teams to accelerate delivery through reusable prompt/agent patterns, evaluation harnesses and disciplined release management. YOUR CHALLENGE: - Agentic Systems Architecture:Design and evolve enterprise agent frameworks including orchestration, tool/function calling, workflow integration, retrieval/grounding and state managementDevelop reusable agent infrastructure (“Agent Factory”) consisting of modular agent templates, tool adapters, prompt modules, evaluation pipelines, and reference implementations to enable scalable and consistent deployment.Engineer structured single-agent and multi-agent systems with clearly defined reasoning boundaries, escalation paths and autonomy levelsDefine architectural patterns for distributed agent workflows across domains and business Pods - Design and evolve enterprise agent frameworks including orchestration, tool/function calling, workflow integration, retrieval/grounding and state management - Develop reusable agent infrastructure (“Agent Factory”) consisting of modular agent templates, tool adapters, prompt modules, evaluation pipelines, and reference implementations to enable scalable and consistent deployment. - Engineer structured single-agent and multi-agent systems with clearly defined reasoning boundaries, escalation paths and autonomy levels - Define architectural patterns for distributed agent workflows across domains and business Pods - Reliable LLM Engineering:Implement reliability patterns for LLM-based systems including fallback strategies, structured output validation, deterministic routing and failure containment mechanismsOptimize latency, token efficiency and cost-per-interaction while maintaining quality thresholdsApply context management and grounding techniques to ensure predictable and auditable behavior - Implement reliability patterns for LLM-based systems including fallback strategies, structured output validation, deterministic routing and failure containment mechanisms - Optimize latency, token efficiency and cost-per-interaction while maintaining quality thresholds - Design and maintain evaluation harnesses including regression suites, golden conversations and structured scoring frameworks Define measurable acceptance thresholds and release readiness criteria - Monitor production behavior including grounding quality, hallucination risk, escalation patterns and performance metrics - Examples of what you’ll help build:AI Agents to Enhance Customer Operations: Design and implement intelligent agents that analyze customer requests, identify root causes, and suggest effective resolution paths, helping improve service quality, consistency and operational efficiencyExpansion of an Enterprise Multi-Agent Framework: Develop and integrate new specialized agents into a scalable multi-agent architecture to automate workflows, support internal teams, and continuously improve operational processesDeployment of AI Copilots for Internal Teams: Work closely with business stakeholders to introduce task-focused AI copilots that assist with activities such as case analysis, information retrieval, and process coordination, reducing manual effort and accelerating turnaround times - • Aufgaben effizient. - Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service. jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager 80-100% (fixed-term, 9 months)
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. Join Our Team as a Customer Experience Manager! Are you passionate about enhancing customer satisfaction and driving excellence? In this pivotal role, you will elevate our customer experience by mapping the end-to-end journey, redesigning and implementing innovative processes, ensuring operational readiness, and spreading the customer’s voice within our organization. Apply now and be part of our Customer Journey Excellence team, as part of Flanker Brands organization! YOUR CHALLENGE: - Define
• Requirements: Utilize Agile or Waterfall methodologies to map user journeys, identify journey gaps, define project requirements, and lead operational readiness. Translate complex information into clear, written requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences - Documentation and Analysis: Review, analyze, and create detailed documentation for business rules and work instructions for our agents. Collaborate with key stakeholders to refine agent training and customer’s communication. Create business cases and deep data analysis to identify customer’s needs and measure the post go live effect of our activities - Customer Service SPOC: Serve as the primary contact for Customer Service topics, offering guidance on requirement coverage, processes, and customer experience impacts. Facilitate, negotiate, and mediate between technical and business teams to ensure decisions, enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency - Customer Advocacy: Represent the customer's voice within Flanker Brands to continuously improve customer satisfaction - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with core team members, including Product Managers, Business PMs, IT PMs, trainers, developers, and testers - Go live Support: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validations to ensure solutions meet business needs and customer expectations YOUR SKILLS: - At least 3 years of experience in Business Analysis or Process/Project Management, preferably within telecommunications - Experience working with Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies - Strong focus on customer experience and process improvement with a digital-first mindset - Analytical thinker with a proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to adapt to changing business needs - Ability to manage shifting priorities and adapt to evolving directions - Excellent communication, storytelling, interpersonal, teamwork, and organizational skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences effectively At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-ST1

jobs.title: Sales Agent Bellinzona 60-100%
jobs.description: In Sunrise pensiamo in grande, andiamo oltre le convenzioni e forgiamo l’innovazione. Per noi cultura del lavoro significa realizzare grandi cose insieme. Qui, il rispetto e le nuove idee danno vita al vero lavoro di squadra: ogni voce viene valorizzata e ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a sperimentare cose nuove e a crescere costantemente. Ti riconosci in questo approccio? Allora, contribuisci a scrivere insieme a noi una storia di successo. Gli eroi del Frontline rappresentano l'orgoglio e l'eccellenza di Sunrise. Con soluzioni personalizzate e un servizio di primo ordine, essi trasformano ogni interazione con i clienti in un rapporto duraturo e di fiducia. LA TUA CHALLENGE: - Sei il volto di Sunrise e conquisti i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, la tua consulenza mirata e la vendita dei nostri numerosi prodotti Sunrise. - Instaura relazioni durature con i clienti e garantisci un'atmosfera eccellente nel negozio. - Assisti i clienti per questioni relative a riparazioni e assistenza, agendo in modo professionale e orientato alla soluzione. - Ti occuperai della gestione del magazzino e dell'inventario e svolgerai in modo efficiente le mansioni amministrative. - Vivrai e rappresenterai i valori di Sunrise: innovazione, vicinanza al cliente e servizio eccellente. LE TUE SKILLS: - Hai completato una formazione nel settore della vendita al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nel settore delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale, oppure sei un candidato motivato proveniente da un altro settore con attitudine alla vendita. - Sei entusiasta della tecnologia, delle telecomunicazioni e delle tendenze digitali. - La tua passione per la vendita è palpabile e il tuo atteggiamento professionale ti rendono un vero professionista delle vendite. - Ti piace lavorare con le persone e sei in grado di individuare rapidamente le loro esigenze. - Grazie alla tua pazienza e alle tue conoscenze tecniche, diventerai un eroe quotidiano per i nostri clienti. - Hai un'ottima conoscenza dell'italiano, ogni altra lingua è un plus. - Hai una grande flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura mentale per un settore in rapida evoluzione. Da Sunrise, lavoriamo in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale dove ogni voce conta, le prospettive si condividono e i valori si vivono. La diversità è nel nostro DNA. Celebrando le differenze, otteniamo grandi risultati insieme. Sunrise è partner di «Advance Gender Equality in Business», titolare del marchio svizzero LGBTI e certificata «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» per la parità retributiva a parità di lavoro. Unisciti al nostro team e plasmiamo insieme il futuro! #ChallengersWanted Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura inviati da agenzie di collocamento non saranno considerati e verranno cancellati. #LI-TW1

descriptionByLocale.en: In Sunrise we think great, we go beyond conventions and we provide innovation. For us culture of work means creating great things together. Here, respect and new ideas give life to true teamwork: each voice is valued and every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to experience new things and to grow constantly. Do you recognize yourself in this approach? So, help us write a success story together. The heroes of the Frontline represent the pride and excellence of Sunrise. With customized solutions and a first-order service, they transform each interaction with customers into a lasting and trusted relationship. - You are the face of Sunrise and conquer our customers with your positive charism, your targeted advice and the sale of our many Sunrise products. - Establish lasting relationships with customers and ensure an excellent atmosphere in the store. - Assist customers for repair and service issues, acting in a professional and solution-oriented manner. - You will manage the warehouse and inventory and perform administrative tasks efficiently. - You will live and represent Sunrise values: innovation, customer proximity and excellent service. LE TUE SKILLS: - You have completed a training in the retail sector, ideally with experience in the telecommunications or multimedia sector, or are a motivated candidate from another sector with aptitude for sale. - You are excited about technology, telecommunications and digital trends. - Your passion for sale is palpable and your professional attitude makes you a real sales professional. - You like to work with people and you are able to quickly identify their needs. Thanks to your patience and technical knowledge, you will become a daily hero for our customers. - You have an excellent knowledge of Italian, every other language is a plus. - You have great flexibility, reliability and mental openness for a rapidly changing industry. From Sunrise, we work in a dynamic and international environment where each voice counts, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity is in our DNA. Celebrating differences, we get great results together. Sunrise is a partner of «Advance Gender Equality in Business», owner of the Swiss LGBTI brand and certified «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» for equal pay. Join our team and we welcome the future together! #ChallengersWanted Note for agencies: application documents sent by employment agencies will not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-TW1

descriptionByLocale.fr: À Sunrise, nous pensons bien, nous allons au-delà des conventions et nous fournissons l'innovation. Pour nous, la culture du travail signifie créer de grandes choses ensemble. Ici, le respect et les idées nouvelles donnent vie à un véritable travail d'équipe : chaque voix est appréciée et chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à vivre de nouvelles choses et à grandir constamment. Vous reconnaissez-vous dans cette approche? Alors aidez-nous à écrire une histoire de réussite ensemble. Les héros de la Frontline représentent la fierté et l'excellence de Sunrise. Avec des solutions personnalisées et un service de première commande, elles transforment chaque interaction avec les clients en une relation durable et fiable. - Vous êtes le visage de Sunrise et conquérez nos clients avec votre charisme positif, vos conseils ciblés et la vente de nos nombreux produits Sunrise. - Établir des relations durables avec les clients et assurer une excellente atmosphère dans le magasin. - Aider les clients pour les problèmes de réparation et de service, agir de manière professionnelle et orientée vers la solution. - Vous gérerez l'entrepôt et l'inventaire et effectuerez les tâches administratives efficacement. - Vous vivrez et représenterez les valeurs de Sunrise : innovation, proximité client et excellent service. LE TUE COMPETENCES: - Vous avez suivi une formation dans le secteur du commerce de détail, idéalement avec de l'expérience dans le secteur des télécommunications ou du multimédia, ou êtes un candidat motivé d'un autre secteur avec aptitude à la vente. - Vous êtes excité par la technologie, les télécommunications et les tendances numériques. - Votre passion pour la vente est palpable et votre attitude professionnelle vous fait un vrai professionnel de vente. - Vous aimez travailler avec les gens et vous êtes capable d'identifier rapidement leurs besoins. Grâce à votre patience et à vos connaissances techniques, vous deviendrez un héros quotidien pour nos clients. - Vous avez une excellente connaissance de l'italien, toutes les autres langues sont un plus. - Vous avez une grande flexibilité, fiabilité et ouverture mentale pour une industrie en évolution rapide. De Sunrise, nous travaillons dans un environnement dynamique et international où chaque voix compte, les perspectives sont partagées et les valeurs sont vécues. La diversité est dans notre ADN. Célébrant les différences, nous obtenons de bons résultats ensemble. Sunrise est partenaire de «Advance Gender Equality in Business», propriétaire de la marque suisse LGBTI et certifié «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» pour un salaire égal. jobs.title: Social Media Storyteller 60-80%
jobs.description: At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story. We are looking for a Social Media Storyteller to join the in-house Social Media & Digital Content team at Sunrise. In this role, you will create engaging, platform-specific content that brings our Flanker brand yallo to life and builds strong connections with our community. From idea to execution, you will shape stories through text, images, and video – both behind the scenes and in front of the camera. As a social host, you’ll represent yallo on channels like Instagram and TikTok, giving our brand a relatable face and voice. In addition you are in charge of the post-production of all Social Media content for yallo. This position requires a strong sense for storytelling, visual creativity, on-camera confidence, and the ability to manage multiple touchpoints and stakeholders. YOUR CHALLENGE: - Create, script, film, and edit social-first content for Instagram and TikTok, and more (eg YouTube shorts) – from concept to final cut - Act as an on-camera Social Host for yallo’s social channels, bringing energy, personality, and authenticity to our stories - Develop engaging social media content in close alignment with the campaign and content calendar as well as product prioritities - Capture and document real-life moments from store visits, product drops, events and employee stories - Collaborate with internal teams to identify stories, source content, and adapt messaging for social - Monitor trends and platform dynamics to proactively suggest new formats and creative ideas YOUR SKILLS: - Degree or professional training in Content Creation, Digital Marketing, Media, Communication or a related field - 3–5 years of experience in social media content creation – with a portfolio that includes video, short-form storytelling, and on-camera work - Confident in front of the camera and comfortable hosting stories, reels, or TikToks - Skilled in video production and editing (e.g. CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar) and image editing (e.g. Photoshop) - Strong understanding of platform best practices, formats, and trend dynamics – especially on Instagram and TikTok - Creative, proactive, and collaborative mindset with the ability to take ideas from concept to execution - Native in Swiss German and fluent in German and English (spoken and written); French and Italian are a plus (spoken) At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-KD1

jobs.title: Sales Agent Zürich Flughafen 60-100%
jobs.description:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte. Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection. DEINE CHALLENGE: - Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte. - Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und sorgst für eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Shop. - Du unterstützt Kundinnen und Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceanliegen und agierst dabei professionell und lösungsorientiert. - Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative
• Aufgaben effizient. - Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service. DEINE SKILLS: - Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimediabranche – oder du bist ein/e motivierte/r Quereinsteiger/-in mit Verkaufsflair. - Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends. - Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi. - Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen. - Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden. - Du bringst die nötige Flexibilität mit, um im Schichtbetrieb in einem Shop zu arbeiten, der an sieben Tagen pro Woche geöffnet ist – dazu gehören regelmässige Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze. - Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus. Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert. Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft! #ChallengersWanted Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungsunterlagen, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichen Stellen eingesandt oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht und werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht. #LI-TW1

jobs.description:
A Sunrise, pensiamo più grande, andare oltre e creare nuove cose. Per noi, lavorare la cultura significa creare grandi cose insieme. Qui il rispetto e le idee fresche incontrano il lavoro di squadra reale – ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a osare cose nuove e a crescere costantemente. Ti sembra? Allora diventa parte della nostra storia di successo. I nostri eroi di prima linea sono l'ammiraglia di Sunrise. Punteggi con soluzioni personalizzate e servizio superiore - così ogni contatto cliente diventa una connessione a lungo termine. Siamo alla ricerca di veri sfidanti – e trovare il negozio giusto per voi! Vuoi fare parte del nostro team, ma non sei sicuro di quale posizione sia meglio per te? Nessun problema. Dopo aver ricevuto la vostra richiesta, controlliamo i vostri documenti e li confrontiamo con i posti vacanti nei nostri negozi nella regione di Zurigo. È così che funziona: 1. Applicare: Invia il tuo dossier completo direttamente online. Assicuratevi di includere tutti i documenti rilevanti come i certificati di lavoro e i diplomi. Inoltre, rispondi ad alcune domande sulla tua disponibilità – in modo da poterti assegnare in modo ottimale ad un negozio adatto. 2. Esame: Controlliamo la vostra esperienza e desideri e li confrontiamo con i posti vacanti attuali nei nostri negozi. Entro una settimana, di solito riceverete il feedback iniziale da noi. 3. Invitation: Se il tuo profilo ci si adatta, ti invitiamo a una conversazione virtuale con uno dei nostri Store Manager. Cogliete questa opportunità per convincervi – preparatevi a coinvolgere il mondo dei prodotti di Sunrise e i nostri valori aziendali. La tua sfida:
• Sei il volto di Sunrise e ispira i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, il tuo consiglio mirato e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise.
• Costruire relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine e fornire un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio.
• Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e servizio e agisci professionalmente e orientata alla soluzione.
• Tenere traccia delle scorte e dell'inventario ed eseguire in modo efficiente i compiti amministrativi.
• Vivi e rappresenti i valori Sunrise – innovazione, prossimità del cliente e servizio eccellente. I tuoi omicidi:
• Hai completato un apprendistato nel commercio al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nell'industria delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale – o sei un concorrente laterale motivato con un tocco di vendita.
• Voi siete appassionati di tecnologia, telecomunicazioni e tendenze digitali.
• La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo aspetto professionale ti rende un vero professionista delle vendite.
• Ti piace trattare con le persone e la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente le loro esigenze.
• Grazie alla vostra pazienza e comprensione tecnica, diventerete un eroe di tutti i giorni per i nostri clienti.
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco, ogni altra lingua è un plus.
• Portate molta flessibilità, affidabilità e apertura a un settore in rapida evoluzione. A Sunrise, si lavora in un ambiente dinamico e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive sono condivise e i valori sono vissuti. La diversità non è solo un programma per noi, ma parte del nostro DNA. Perché celebriamo le nostre differenze, otteniamo grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è un partner di Advance Gender Equality in Business, l'etichetta LGBTI svizzera e certificata con Fair-ON-Pay Advanced per un lavoro di pari valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora diventa parte del team e forma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted nota per le agenzie: I documenti di domanda presentati o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o enti simili non sono desiderati e quindi non sono considerati e cancellati. #LI-TW1 #

descriptionByLocale.en:
In Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new things. For us, working culture means creating great things together. Here respect and fresh ideas meet real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to bear new things and grow constantly. Does that sound like you? Then it becomes part of our success story. Our first-line heroes are the flagship of Sunrise. Tips with customized solutions and superior service - so each customer contact becomes a long-term connection. We are looking for real challengers – and find the right store for you! You want to be part of our team, but aren't you sure which position is best for you? No problem. After receiving your request, we check your documents and compare them with vacancies in our stores in the Zurich region. That's how it works: 1. Apply: Send your complete dossier directly online. Be sure to include all relevant documents such as work certificates and diplomas. Also, answer some questions about your availability – so you can optimally assign yourself to a suitable store. 2. Exam: We check your experience and wishes and compare them with current vacancies in our stores. Within a week, you will usually receive initial feedback from us. 3. Invitation: If your profile fits, we invite you to a virtual conversation with one of our Store Managers. Take this opportunity to convince you – get ready to involve the world of Sunrise products and our company values. Your challenge:
• You are the face of Sunrise and inspire our customers with your positive charism, your targeted advice and the sale of our various Sunrise products.
• Build relationships with long-term customers and provide a first-class atmosphere in the store.
• Support customers with repair and service issues and act professionally and solution oriented.
• Track inventory and inventory and perform administrative tasks efficiently.
• Experience and represent the Sunrise values – innovation, customer proximity and excellent service. Your murders:
• You have completed an apprenticeship in retail trade, ideally experienced in the telecommunications or multimedia industry – or you are a motivated side competitor with a touch of sales.
• You are passionate about technology, telecommunications and digital trends.
• Your passion for sales is obvious and your professional appearance makes you a real sales professional.
• You like to deal with people and the ability to quickly recognize their needs.
• Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will become a daily hero for our customers.
• You have a good knowledge of German, every other language is a plus.
• Bring flexibility, reliability and openness to a rapidly changing industry. In Sunrise, you work in a dynamic and multinational environment where each voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity is not just a program for us, but part of our DNA. Because we celebrate our differences, we get great things together. Sunrise is a partner of Advance Gender Equality in Business, the Swiss LGBTI label and certified with Fair-ON-Pay Advanced for equal value work for all. Are you ready for the challenge? Then he becomes part of the team and actively forms our future! #ChallengersWanted note for agencies: Application documents submitted or uploaded by employment agencies or similar entities are not desired and are therefore not considered and deleted. #LI-TW1 #
